en.site_subtitle: Listen to the Music of Nature
en.theme_forest_desc: Immerse yourself in the ancient whispers of towering trees, birdsong echoing through the canopy, and the gentle rustle of leaves in the breeze.
en.theme_ocean_desc: Feel the rhythm of endless waves crashing against the shore, the cry of seagulls, and the soothing murmur of the tide.
en.theme_lake_desc: Experience the tranquil stillness of mirror-like waters, the soft lapping of gentle waves, and the peaceful chorus of lakeside life.
en.theme_spring_desc: Discover the crystal-clear melody of water flowing over stones, the refreshing splash of a natural spring, and the harmony of the forest stream.
en.about_p1: Nature's Symphony is an immersive audio-visual experience that brings the soothing sounds of the natural world directly to you. Each theme captures the authentic ambiance of a unique natural environment, recorded in high fidelity to transport you to serene landscapes around the globe.
en.about_p2: Whether you seek relaxation, meditation, focus, or simply a moment of peace, our curated soundscapes provide the perfect backdrop. Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and let nature's music wash over you.
en.about_p3: All audio recordings are sourced from free, open-source nature sound libraries. Images are carefully selected to complement each soundscape and create a fully immersive experience.
en.about_sounds_desc: All sound recordings are sourced from free nature sound archives and are available for personal, non-commercial use.
en.about_images_desc: All images are sourced from Unsplash and Pexels, free for personal and commercial use.
en.disclaimer_text: This website is for personal relaxation and entertainment purposes only. All audio and image materials are sourced from free, open-source libraries. We do not claim ownership of the original recordings or photographs. This site is not affiliated with any commercial entity. Use at your own discretion.

zh.theme_forest_desc: 沉浸在古老树木的低语中，鸟鸣回荡在林冠之间，微风轻拂树叶沙沙作响。
zh.theme_ocean_desc: 感受无尽海浪拍打海岸的节奏，海鸥的鸣叫，以及潮汐轻柔的呢喃。
zh.theme_lake_desc: 体验如镜水面的宁静，轻柔波浪的拍打，以及湖畔生活的和平合唱。
zh.theme_spring_desc: 发现清澈泉水流过石头的旋律，天然泉源的清新飞溅，以及林间溪流的和谐。
zh.about_p1: 聆听大自然是一个沉浸式音视频体验项目，将自然世界的舒缓声音直接带给您。每个主题都捕捉了独特自然环境的真实氛围，以高保真录制，将您带到全球宁静的自然景观中。
zh.about_p2: 无论您是寻求放松、冥想、专注，还是仅仅想要片刻宁静，我们精心策划的声音景观都能提供完美的背景。闭上眼睛，深呼吸，让大自然的音乐洗涤您的心灵。
zh.about_p3: 所有音频录音均来源于免费的开源自然声音库。图片经过精心挑选，以配合每个声音景观，创造完全沉浸式的体验。
zh.about_sounds_desc: 所有声音录音均来源于免费的自然声音档案库，仅供个人非商业用途使用。
zh.about_images_desc: 所有图片均来源于 Unsplash 和 Pexels，可免费用于个人和商业用途。
zh.disclaimer_text: 本网站仅供个人放松和娱乐使用。所有音频和图片素材均来源于免费的开源库。我们不声明拥有原始录音或照片的所有权。本网站不与任何商业实体有关联。请自行斟酌使用。
